description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number when you use paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned in the paging result.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为10，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page when you use paged query. Default value: 10, which indicates that each page contains 10 entries in the paging result.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh:
敏感数据类型。
> 您可以调用[DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~)获取支持敏感数据类型。
description.en:
The type of sensitive data.
> You can call [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) to obtain the supported sensitive data types.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

title.zh: 查询敏感数据溯源结果
